basis: CC sucrose/H+ symporter for apoplastic loading (Truernit & Sauer 1995 Planta; Stadler & Sauer 1996). Lee 2025 stem c9 DE 0.89 vs 0.38; independent CC cluster marker in Nobori 2025, Tenorio Berrio 2025 and Zhang 2021 (other organs). Grasses load via SUT1 clade. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): does not peak in APL nuclei (top VND7, 1.08x): companion cells are weakly captured by APL FANS.

PM H+-ATPase, CC promoter-GUS (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell); stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4i) and c9 DE 0.89 vs 0.47; CC cluster in Kim 2021 and Tenorio Berrio 2025 (independent). Shared with developing SE. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): APL 2.2x.

Phloem lectin of companion cells (Dinant et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) but weak c9 DE (0.31 vs 0.16); CC reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 and CC cluster in Kim 2021 (independent). Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): does not peak in APL nuclei (top NST3, 1.04x).

Phloem-mobile HMA protein expressed in CC (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell); cited for Lee 2025 stem c9 but DE there is weak (0.28 vs 0.19) and stronger in the floral contaminant c14 (0.58 vs 0.19). Raised from low by Nobori 2025 CC cluster (independent). Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): APL (phloem) nuclei 3.7x.
Sucrose synthase; Lee 2025 stem c9 DE 0.93 vs 0.32; not reported as a CC marker in the other reviewed Arabidopsis datasets. Single-study enrichment.

MYB-related TF required for SE and CC identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) though not DE in snRNA; independent agreement in Shahan 2022 root and Zhang 2021 shoot apex. Shi 2021: sorting promoter for phloem (Fig 1H); 1.5x in APL nuclei; LCM phloem cap vs bundle log2FC 1.83.
Glycine-rich protein (uncharacterized); stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4h) and top c9 CC-cluster DE (0.71 vs 0.39). One study (the flower-sibling row is the same atlas).
Metallothionein with phloem promoter-GUS (Guo et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); Lee 2025 stem c9 DE 0.89 vs 0.57 (broad, poor specificity).
bHLH TF; stem phloem by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not DE in any stem snRNA cluster.
CAP-superfamily PR-1-like protein; stem phloem by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not DE in snRNA. Defence gene: check for immune states.
FAF-like DUF3049 protein. CONFLICT: Lee 2025 MERFISH places it in the stem 'procambium' domain (Ext. Data Fig. 4c) but snRNA DE is in CC cluster c9 (0.69 vs 0.35). Treat as phloem/cambium-zone gene.

Strigolactone-independent SMXL needed for phloem formation; reporter in developing phloem / phloem-side cambium of the inflorescence stem (Wallner et al. 2017 Curr Biol). Literature only: not DE in Lee 2025 stem. ID from UniProt Q9LU73. Raised medium->high: SMXL5pro sorting line in Shi 2021 (distal cambium + developing phloem, Fig 1G; mRNA 2.7x next, SDS15 SMXL5-specific) plus independent phloem clusters in Zhang 2021 shoot apex and Shahan 2022 root (sibling drafts). Shi 2021 and Wallner 2017 are the same lab.

Early-phloem DOF driving periclinal divisions (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); peaks in Shi 2021 SMXL5 (developing phloem) nuclei (Fig 4O, 2.35x). Raised medium->high by Shahan 2022 protophloem and Lyu 2025 phloem-side reporter (root draft, independent).

Early-phloem DOF (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); peaks in Shi 2021 SMXL5 nuclei (Fig 4P, 1.5x); on the phloem trajectory in Moreno-Ramirez 2026 (unreviewed). Lee 2025 stem DE is in the guard/myrosin c5 (0.64 vs 0.17), not c9: not raised.
AWPM-19-like membrane protein; promoter-ER-GFP in phloem/phloem cap (Shi 2021 Fig 7E); APL nuclei 6.8x (SDS15 APL). Raised medium->high by Lee 2025 stem CC cluster c9 DE (0.75 vs 0.40; independent).
Uncharacterized protein; promoter-ER-GFP in phloem/phloem cap (Shi 2021 Fig 7F); APL nuclei 9.8x, LCM cap log2FC 2.08. Lee 2025 c9 DE weak (0.32 vs 0.22): not raised.
Flavin monooxygenase (paper's 'FMO'); promoter-ER-GFP in phloem (Shi 2021 Fig 7D); SMXL5 nuclei 2.3x (SDS15 SMXL5). One study.

SE-specific callose synthase for sieve-plate callose (Xie et al. 2011 Plant J); Lee 2025 stem DE in CC cluster c9 (0.79 vs 0.36), i.e. developing SE nuclei sit with CC; independent SE marker in Zhang 2021 shoot apex and root secondary-growth atlas. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): APL 1.75x; LCM phloem cap log2FC 1.33.

Sieve-element occlusion filament protein, developing SEs only (Froelich et al. 2011 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 stem DE c4 (0.58 vs 0.30) and weakly c9; raised by Zhang 2021 shoot apex and Tenorio Berrio 2025 (independent). Shi 2021: peaks in APL (phloem) nuclei (Fig 4B, 1.6x).

Early-nodulin-like protein with SE-specific promoter (Khan et al. 2007 Plant Physiol); SE cluster in Zhang 2021 shoot apex. CONFLICT: Lee 2025 stem MERFISH calls it 'procambium' (Ext. Data Fig. 4c, legend 'ENDOL9'); snRNA DE c4 (0.63 vs 0.25). Not raised because of the conflict. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): APL (phloem) nuclei 10.7x any other population, which supports the SE/phloem call over the Lee 2025 MERFISH 'procambium' domain.
NAC TF driving SE enucleation (Furuta et al. 2014 Science); peaks in Shi 2021 APL nuclei (Fig 4C, 1.8x); SE reporter and cluster in Lyu 2025 root (independent). Developing SE only.
NAC TF redundant with NAC086 for SE enucleation (Furuta et al. 2014 Science); Shi 2021 APL nuclei 2.1x (table only). Developing SE only.
Amino-acid-transporter-like protein; promoter-ER-YFP in the phloem cap (Shi 2021 Fig 9A); LCM cap vs bundle log2FC 2.97 (SDS15 phloem cap), flat in FANS. One study.
myo-Inositol-3-phosphate synthase; promoter-ER-YFP in the phloem cap (Shi 2021 Fig 9C); LCM cap log2FC 2.26; also APL/SMXL5 nuclei. One study.

Aliphatic glucosinolate R2R3-MYB; promoter-ER-YFP in phloem cap plus xylem (Shi 2021 Fig 9B); LCM cap log2FC 2.53, also high in PXY/NST3 nuclei. Review graded `function`; set to characterized_enriched because the function marks a metabolic program, not the cap (leaf draft has it in Bundle_Sheath, fruit draft as Glucosinolate_Producing).

Aliphatic glucosinolate P450; cap localization cited from Nintemann et al. 2018 (not re-read); LCM cap log2FC 1.52 (Shi 2021 Fig 5D), also high in PXY nuclei. Leaf draft: bundle-sheath reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025). Review graded `function`; changed for the same reason as MYB29.
Aliphatic glucosinolate P450; LCM cap log2FC 2.19 (Shi 2021), also high in PXY nuclei; no stem reporter. Vein-wide in the leaf draft. Review graded `function`; changed as for MYB29.

NAC master regulator of metaxylem vessel differentiation (Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev); Lee 2025 stem c8 DE 0.73 vs 0.37; independent xylem cluster in root secondary-growth atlas. Developing vessels only. Shi 2021: peaks in VND7 (developing vessel) nuclei (Fig 4I, 4.0x).

Xylem cysteine protease in tracheary-element autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4l) and c8 DE 0.71 vs 0.35; in the skill table. Shi 2021: VND7 nuclei 10.2x next (SDS15 VND7-specific).
Xylem cysteine protease, TE-specific promoter (Funk et al. 2002 Plant Physiol); Lee 2025 stem c8 DE 0.66 vs 0.23; in the skill table. Shi 2021: peaks in VND7 nuclei (Fig 4J, 5.4x).

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; irx3 collapsed xylem (Turner & Somerville 1997 Plant Cell). Stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4k), not DE in snRNA; xylem cluster in Shahan 2022 (independent). Also interfascicular fibers. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 1.5x (NST3 second).

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Taylor et al. 2000 Plant Cell); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); xylem in Shahan 2022 (independent). Also interfascicular fibers. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 3.4x (NST3 second).

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (Taylor et al. 2003 PNAS); Lee 2025 stem DE only in mixed c4 (0.81 vs 0.70, weak); xylem in Shahan 2022 (independent). Also interfascicular fibers. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 2.2x (NST3 second).

Xylan/pectin glycosyltransferase needed for secondary walls (Persson et al. 2007 Plant Cell); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and c4 DE 0.55 vs 0.34. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 2.4x.
Laccase for lignin polymerization, irx12 (Brown et al. 2005 Plant Cell; Berthet et al. 2011 Plant Cell); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not DE. Also interfascicular fibers.

Laccase for G-lignin in interfascicular fibers and protoxylem (Berthet et al. 2011 Plant Cell); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); c4 DE has pct 0.43 vs 0.49 (not enriched in snRNA). Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 2.2x (NST3 second).

Secondary-wall master MYB downstream of SND1/VND (Zhong et al. 2007 Plant Cell); Lee 2025 stem DE c8 (0.61 vs 0.53), c13 and c4 (weak); xylem in Shahan 2022 (independent). Fibers and vessels. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 1.9x (NST3 second).

Thermospermine synthase preventing premature xylem cell death (Muniz et al. 2008 Development); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3). CONFLICT: snRNA DE is higher in CC cluster c9 (0.85 vs 0.36) than in the 'Xylem' c3 it was used to call (0.53 vs 0.36). Xylem in Shahan 2022 and Zhang 2021, kept medium because of the stem conflict. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 4.1x and not enriched in APL nuclei, which resolves the Lee 2025 c9 conflict in favour of xylem.

UDP-xylose synthase (xylan precursor); stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and c8 DE 0.88 vs 0.51. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 3.1x.

Germin-like protein; stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); DE in c8, c4 and c13 (secondary-wall clusters). Raised low->medium by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): VND7 3.3x.
Monolignol oxidoreductase (BBE-like 13); stem xylem by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not in the review's marker list.
Uncharacterized protein; stem xylem by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3); not DE.

NAC master switch for vessel differentiation (Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev); sorting promoter for early vessel elements in the stem (Shi 2021 Fig 1F; 2.4x in VND7 nuclei); protoxylem marker in Shahan 2022 root (independent). Developing vessels only.
VND-family NAC of vessel differentiation; Shi 2021 VND7 nuclei 4.2x (SDS15 VND7), VND binding sites enriched in the VND7 co-expression cluster. One study.

VND-family NAC of vessel differentiation; Shi 2021 VND7 nuclei 3.3x (SDS15 VND7). Raised medium->high by xylem clusters in Liew 2024 seed and Lee 2025 inflorescence (sibling drafts; independent of Shi). Not enriched in Lee 2025 stem c8 (0.63 vs 0.67).
Nuclease of xylem programmed cell death; Shi 2021 VND7 nuclei 7.2x (SDS15 VND7). Also a senescence gene (seed draft: Senescing): use only with VND/XCP markers.
VND7-induced LBD promoting vessel differentiation; Shi 2021 VND7 nuclei 4.3x (not in SDS15). One study.

Secondary-wall NAC; nst1 nst3 lacks secondary walls in interfascicular and xylem fibers (Mitsuda et al. 2007 Plant Cell). Also in xylem fibers/anther endothecium: require absence of vessel markers (VND6/XCP). Not DE in Lee 2025 stem. ID from UniProt Q84WP6. Shi 2021: peaks in NST3 (fiber) nuclei (Fig 4G) but only 1.3x the next population; not raised.

Fiber secondary-wall NAC; promoter in interfascicular and xylem fibers, not vessels (Zhong et al. 2006 Plant Cell). Not DE in Lee 2025 stem. ID from UniProt Q9LPI7. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021: NST3pro::H4-GFP labels interfascicular plus xylem fibers in the stem (Fig 1E) and NST3 mRNA peaks in NST3 nuclei (1.5x next, small margin; that population also carries xylem and possibly chlorenchyma).

Uncharacterized protein; promoter-ER-GFP in interfascicular fibers and vessels (Shi 2021 Fig 7A); NST3 nuclei 5.0x (SDS15 NST3). Lee 2025 stem DE in secondary-wall clusters c4 (0.50 vs 0.31) and c13 (0.48 vs 0.33), which are not fiber-labelled; not raised.

HD-ZIP III TF of procambium and xylem precursors (Baima et al. 1995 Development); translational reporter in IM procambial strands feeding the primary stem (Moreno-Ramirez 2026 Fig. 2K). Not DE in Lee 2025 stem. Also in the skill table. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): top in VND7 nuclei (1.9x), PXY second: also marks xylem precursors.

TDIF/CLE41 receptor maintaining procambium/cambium division (Fisher & Turner 2007 Curr Biol; Hirakawa et al. 2008 PNAS); on the cambium trajectory in Moreno-Ramirez 2026. Not DE in Lee 2025 stem. Shi 2021: sorting promoter for proximal cambium plus differentiating xylem (Fig 1D), but PXY mRNA is only 1.07x in PXY nuclei and is high in LCM pith; not raised. Pair with WOX4.

WAT1-related amino acid exporter; stem 'procambium' domain by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4c); not DE in snRNA. The domain also holds ENODL9 (an SE gene), so it may be cambium plus developing phloem.
bHLH TF; stem 'procambium' domain by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4c); not DE. CONFLICT: Shahan 2022 lists it for root pericycle.

Homeobox TF downstream of PXY needed for (pro)cambium proliferation in stem vascular bundles (Hirakawa et al. 2010 Plant Cell; Suer et al. 2011 Plant Cell). Not DE in Lee 2025 stem. ID from UniProt Q6X7J9. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021: peaks in PXY (proximal cambium) nuclei (Fig 4L, 1.8x next) and is absent from LCM pith.

AP2 TF of cambium stem cells; promoter-ER-GFP in the stem cambium (Shi 2021 Fig 8A; SMXL5 nuclei 1.5x, LCM cap log2FC 1.24). Raised medium->high by Eswaran et al. 2024 Science (cambium stem-cell factor, independent; root draft). Also in organ primordia at the apex (shoot_apex draft).
Heavy-metal-associated isoprenylated protein; promoter-ER-GFP in cambium plus cortex (Shi 2021 Fig 8F); SMXL5 nuclei only 1.07x.
DOF TF; promoter-ER-GFP in phloem cap, phloem and distal cambium (Shi 2021 Fig 8E); SMXL5 nuclei 1.5x. Not cambium-specific.
B-box zinc finger; stem cortex by MERFISH in one section (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4e); not DE in snRNA (cortex was never assigned a cluster).

Putative peptide transporter (uncharacterized); stem cortex by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Ext. Data Fig. 4f); not DE. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): highest in NST3 nuclei (2.2x) and up in LCM pith (log2FC 1.96): not cortex-specific.
LHCII subunit; stem cortex (chlorenchyma) by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Supp. Table 3) and DE in unlabelled c6 (0.77 vs 0.55). Photosynthesis gene: ambient RNA, use specificity only.

Aspartyl protease; pAED3::ER-GFP marks cortex and rib zone from primordia down the young primary stem (Moreno-Ramirez 2026 Fig. 4B-C); root cortex marker in Shahan 2022 (CORTEX). Apex-proximal stem only; also rib zone (pith precursors).

IDD zinc-finger TF of root ground-tissue patterning (Welch et al. 2007 Genes Dev); pJKD::JKD-YFP in L2 of primordia and young stem cortex (Moreno-Ramirez 2026 Fig. 4F). Apex only. ID from UniProt Q700D2 (paper gives symbol only).
NAC TF promoting pith programmed cell death (Fujimoto et al. 2018, cited by Shi 2021, not re-read); LCM pith vs bundle log2FC 4.25 (Shi 2021 Fig 5F; SDS15 pith). One study.
Class III peroxidase with known pith expression (Schurholz et al. 2018, cited by Shi 2021); LCM pith log2FC 7.13 (Fig 5G; SDS15 pith).
Arabinogalactan protein; promoter-ER-YFP in pith plus cortex (Shi 2021 Fig 9E); LCM pith log2FC 3.97 (SDS15 pith). Use with absence of cortex markers.
CLE peptide; promoter-ER-YFP in pith but also fibers and cambium (Shi 2021 Fig 9D); LCM pith log2FC 4.3. Root draft lists it for xylem fibers (Lyu 2025, low): not pith-specific.

GRAS TF required for shoot endodermis (starch sheath); sgr1/scr stems lack an endodermis and are agravitropic (Fukaki et al. 1998 Plant J; Wysocka-Diller et al. 2000 Development). In the Lee 2025 MERFISH panel but not DE and no stem endodermis domain reported. ID from UniProt Q9M384. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell (independent stem study): SCRpro::H4-GFP marks the starch sheath (Fig 1I) and SCR mRNA peaks in sorted SCR nuclei (2.7x next population). Also up in LCM pith (log2FC 1.27), so not exclusive.
Auxin efflux carrier of the shoot starch sheath for gravitropism; peaks in Shi 2021 SCR nuclei (Fig 4E, 1.6x; not in SDS15). Also expressed in other shoot tissues. One stem study.
WRKY TF (function not tissue-related); promoter-ER-GFP in starch sheath plus cortex (Shi 2021 Fig 7G); SCR nuclei 14.2x (SDS15 SCR). Use with SCR to exclude cortex.

Epidermis-specific VLCFA elongase; fdh organ fusion (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell). Cited for Lee 2025 stem c10/c12 but DE is weak (c10 0.85 vs 0.68); independent epidermis marker in Nobori 2025 and Zhang 2021. Shi 2021: peaks in LTP1 (epidermis) nuclei (Fig 4R, 2.35x; SDS15 LTP1-specific).

Fatty acyl-CoA reductase for wax primary alcohols, expressed in stem epidermis; cer4 stem wax defect (Rowland et al. 2006 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 stem c10 DE 0.94 vs 0.74. Raised medium->high by Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): LTP1 epidermal nuclei 10.4x.
Wax VLCFA elongase of the epidermis; peaks in Shi 2021 LTP1 (epidermis) nuclei (Fig 4S, 3.7x next; SDS15 LTP1). Independent epidermis marker in the leaf draft (Kim 2021, Nobori 2025, Procko 2022).
Alkane-forming wax aldehyde decarbonylase; Shi 2021 LTP1 nuclei 13.8x next (SDS15; not reporter-tested). Raised medium->high by Xia 2022 leaf Stereo-seq upper epidermis (independent).

GPI-anchored LTP for cuticular wax export (DeBono et al. 2009 Plant Cell); Shi 2021 LTP1 nuclei 3.6x (SDS15). Raised medium->high by the epidermal clusters of Zhang 2021 and Xu 2025 shoot apex (independent).
Glycine-rich protein; promoter-ER-GFP epidermis-only in the stem (Shi 2021 Fig 7H), LTP1 nuclei 8.2x, absent from LCM. Raised medium->high by the epidermis reporter of Procko 2022 leaf (independent).

bHLH TF for GMC-to-guard-cell transition (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 stem c5 DE 0.78 vs 0.26 but c5 lacks KAT1/SLAC1/MYB60 and is likely guard + myrosin cells; FAMA also marks myrosin idioblasts. Guard in Kim 2021 and Tenorio Berrio 2025 (independent).

Monolignol (p-coumaryl alcohol) transporter (Alejandro et al. 2012 Curr Biol); function unrelated to guard cells. Lee 2025 stem c5 DE 0.92 vs 0.52 (c5 = guard + myrosin); guard DE in Kim 2021 leaf (independent). CONFLICT: endodermis-listed in the Lee 2025 root review.
FAMA is required for myrosin-cell development along the phloem (Li & Sack 2014 Plant Cell; Shirakawa et al. 2014 Plant Cell). Use with TGG2 and without KAT1/SLAC1 to separate from guard cells.

Myrosinase of phloem-associated myrosin cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J). Lee 2025 stem c5 DE 0.96 vs 0.76 (weak); myrosin marker in Tenorio Berrio 2025 and Kim 2021 (independent). Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): highest in SCR (starch sheath) nuclei (2.4x) and up in LCM phloem cap (log2FC 2.8). Stem myrosin signal sits near the starch sheath/phloem cap; TGG1/2 cannot separate Endodermis from Myrosin_Idioblast.

Myrosinase in guard cells and phloem myrosin cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J); not specific in Lee 2025 stem (c4 0.74 vs 0.80). Also a guard-cell gene. Husebye et al. 2002 Plant Physiol (characterized_markers.tsv) also localizes TGG1 to phloem idioblasts and guard cells; not raised because it is not specific. Shi 2021 Plant Cell FANS (SDS5 mean normalized counts, top population vs next): SCR nuclei 1.2x; LCM phloem cap log2FC 2.4.

Pollen-specific pectin methylesterase needed for pollen-tube growth (Jiang et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 stem c15 ('Trichome') DE 0.98 vs 0.60: flags pollen contamination in stem samples. Shi 2021 LCM phloem cap vs bundle log2FC 6.1: the LCM cap libraries carry pollen RNA.
Ole e 1-like pollen allergen family; Lee 2025 stem c15 DE 0.96 vs 0.38 only. Contamination flag. Shi 2021 LCM phloem cap vs bundle log2FC 6.8 (pollen RNA in the LCM cap libraries).

Anthocyanidin reductase of proanthocyanidin synthesis, endothelium-specific (Debeaujon et al. 2003 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 stem c12 ('Epidermal') DE 0.80 vs 0.72: flags ovule/young-silique material; endothelium marker in the independent seed atlases.
